values.quote: forming a {{tip|tether}} between '''Kled''' and the target for {{fd|1.75}} seconds

mechanics.claim: The bear trap deals damage to enemies hit by the projectile, and forms a tether against the first champion or large monster hit; the tether later pulls them for the second damage instance.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased to 150% against {{tip|minion|minions}}, small {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monsters}}. The bear trap collides with the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, large pet, or large monster hit

mechanics.claim: The first hit and the tether-pop hit are separate, non-lifesteal-applying damage instances.
The pull damage recalculates dynamically based on Kled's current AD at the moment it triggers, not when the tether was applied.
mechanics.quote: The pull damage is updated dynamically based on '''Kled's''' current attack damage.

mechanics.claim: The tether cannot be broken within the first 0.25 seconds of its application, meaning the pull cannot be avoided immediately.
mechanics.quote: The tether cannot be broken within the first {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|estimated}} seconds of its application.

mechanics.claim: The ability casts toward the cursor position at the start of the cast time, not at its end.
mechanics.quote: The ability will cast to wherever the caster's cursor was at the start of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Bear Trap on a Rope can be cast while Jousting (Kled's E), allowing it during the dash.
mechanics.quote: ''Bear Trap on a Rope can be cast while {{ai|Jousting|Kled}}.''
